Ruuvi sensors send tiny messages over Bluetooth, which can then be picked up by nearby mobile phones or specialised Ruuvi Gateway routers. Ruuvi Station mobile app enables you to collect and visualise this data on your mobile device. Ruuvi Gateway, on the other hand, routes the data over the internet not only to the mobile application but also to the browser application.

Ruuvi Gateway routes the sensor measurement data directly to the Ruuvi Cloud cloud service, which enables you to build a complete remote monitoring solution including remote alerts, sensor sharing and history in Ruuvi Cloud – all available within the Ruuvi Station app! We've all caught the last glimmer of a beautiful Sunrise or Sunset, missing out on a spectacular photo opportunity. Alpenglow tries to make that a thing of the past with both reminder notifications and Sunrise/Sunset quality forecasts.

• Sunrise, Sunset, Golden Hour, and Blue Hour Times.
• Sunrise and Sunset Quality Forecasts. Available up to 4 days into the future with - Alpenglow Plus or Pro.
• Sunrise and Sunset Reminder Alarms.
• Adjust when Alpenglow delivers your Reminder Notification.
• Custom Location Selection to help plan your next photography trip.
• Quickly switch dates using the arrows or the Date Picker.
• Submit Field Reports; reports will be used to improve Sunrise & Sunset Color Forecasts.
• Sunrise, Sunset, and Magic Hour Times Home Screen Widget.
• Sunrise & Sunset Forecast Widget for Alpenglow Pro Users.
• Share Quality Forecasts with Friends & Family.
• Support for Light & Dark Mode.
• Dynamic Type support throughout.
• Also available on your Apple Watch, including Complications for your favorite Watch Face.

Alpenglow will always be free to use, with the ability to unlock additional features with Alpenglow Plus and Alpenglow Pro.

By supporting the development by sending a tip, you'll unlock Alpenglow Plus, gaining access to the additional features...
• See Quality Forecasts further into the future. You'll have access to forecasts for up to 4 days into the future.
• Alpenglow will use a more accurate location to retrieve forecasts, all while keeping your position on your device and never stored online.
• The elevation for your location will be retrieved to calculate more accurate Sunrise, Sunset, and Magic Hour times.
• Select from your recently searched locations, allowing you to quickly check the forecast/times at your favorite spots.
• Adjust Alpenglow's Color Scheme by adjusting the Primary Color.
• Customize the Alpenglow App Icon with Alternative Icons.

Alpenglow Pro unlocks everything from Alpenglow Plus, along with extra features that incur ongoing server costs and additional resources to maintain.
• Forecast Notifications when a Sunrise/Sunset is forecasted to be above your defined threshold.
• Forecast Home Screen Widgets, keep an eye on Sunrise/Sunset forecast(s) right from your home screen.
• Outlook Home Screen Widget, showing you the Forecast up to 4 days into the future.
• Forecast Apple Watch Complications.
• Outlook Complication for the Infograph Modular, Modular Compact Watch Faces.

Share your feedback via the Feedback option in the app or via social media...

Instagram: @alpenglowapp
Reddit: r/Alpenglow

I'd love to see your Sunrise and Sunset shots on Instagram, just tag #alpenglowapp.

Sunrise & Sunset quality forecasts are provided by SunsetWX.com.

Alpenglow Pro Subscriptions automatically renew at the end of each period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.

Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your iTunes & App Store Account Settings after purchase.

A beautifully produced, powerful digital thermometer. Bid farewell to the traditional scale display! Temperature, humidity, feels like at a glance! Support multi-regional data query! Do not hesitate! That's the thermometer you've been looking for!
==Features==
-Intuitive digital display, powerful
-The default location of the current location,can also be manually selected to see other parts of the temperature situation
-Automatically display the current location of temperature and humidity data, and can be manually refreshed at any time
-Supports Fahrenheit temperature and Celsius temperature selection
-Support for humidity and feels like data display- Support for humidity and somatosensory temperature data display
